- [Cache](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/guides/hosting/performance/caches.md): Cache: There are several caches in Shopware that can be used to optimize performance. This page gives a brief overview and shows how to configure them.
- [Cluster Setup](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/guides/hosting/installation-updates/cluster-setup.md): Cluster Setup: The setup of high-scaling systems differs from a normal installation of Shopware. They are completely customized stores with individual templates and extensions.
- [Configurations](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/guides/hosting/configurations.md): Configurations: When running Shopware 6 there are various configuration options you can use to customize your installation. This page will give you an overview of the different configuration options and how they effect Shopware.
- [Custom cache invalidation](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/guides/hosting/performance/custom-cache-invalidation.md): Custom cache invalidation: The current cache system of Shopware is based on a multi-layer system, in which the individual layers build on each other and whose tags are passed on to the upper layer for later invalidation.

Ensure that the Debug-Mode is activated in your .env file.

Also, they increase overall productivity because actual testing can get more attention.

Configuring the messenger to consume this queue will fail if it does not exist.
